params.body:
- Offer and order modals: 900px dialog instead of modal-xl, 10px between rows, labels 13px, fields 38px, the price hints on one line, warranty and extras boxes without dead space.
- Extras: the '+' in the box head sat above the first row's '-' in the same column and read as a pair of loose buttons. Gone; one 'Extra toevoegen' text row always sits under the extras (the empty state and the add action are the same thing now). Same in the order modal.

This is a spacing pass; the real rebuild of these modals stays on the per-screen list after the cutover.
params.title: Offer and order modals: compact, one add-row for extras
